z-m-14-14.title: Sake rubuta umarnin ribbon na ɗaure akwatin kyauta.
z-m-14-14.topic: Tsawon fuskar akwatin murabba'i mai kusurwa huɗu da tsawon ribbon (sake rubuta umarni).
z-m-14-14.goal: Koyi gano tsawon ta bin ainihin hanyar ribbon, sannan ka sake rubuta umarnin kuskure zuwa daidai.
z-m-14-14.material: Akwatin kyautar murabba'i ne mai fadin 20 cm, tsawon 15 cm, tsayin 10 cm. Kana son ɗaure ta da ribbon a siffar gicciye. Ribbon yana ketare tsakiyar fuskar saman akwatin a kusurwar dama, ya gangara kai tsaye bisa gefen fuska, ya sake ketare tsakiyar fuskar ƙasa. Ɗaya yana zagaye akwatin sau ɗaya a hanyar faɗi, ɗayan kuma sau ɗaya a hanyar tsawo. Kada ka kula da kaurin ribbon, ka ƙara 25 cm don kulli da yin baka.
z-m-14-14.thinking.1: Da kanka ka yi ma'aunai da suka cika sharuddan.
z-m-14-14.prereq.0: Faɗi, tsawo, tsayin akwatin murabba'i da kusurwa da matsayen fuskoki (aji na 4 zuwa 5).
z-m-14-14.s.s1.prompt: Soyoung ta nemo tsawon ribbon kamar haka. Zaɓi layi guda da ba daidai ba.
z-m-14-14.s.s1.hint.0: Bi da yatsa fuskokin akwatin da ribbon ɗaya ke bi a jere.
z-m-14-14.s.s1.hint.1: A wannan tsawon, ƙirga sau nawa faɗi, tsawo, da tsayin akwatin kowanne ya shiga.
z-m-14-14.s.s1.line.0: Yi tunanin ribbon yana zagaye gefunan akwatin. Akwatin murabba'i yana da gefuna 12.
z-m-14-14.s.s1.line.1: Akwai gefunan faɗi 4, tsawo 4, tsayi 4, saboda haka 4×(20+15+10)=180 cm.
z-m-14-14.s.s1.line.2: Ƙara 25 cm don kulli da baka, jimillar da ake buƙata 180+25=205 cm ce.
z-m-14-14.s.s1.explain: Kuskure yana farawa a layi na 1. Ribbon da aka ɗaure giciye ba ya bin gefuna; yana bi ta tsakiyar saman da ƙasan akwatin. Saboda haka 180 cm na layi na 2 da 205 cm na layi na 3 ba daidai ba ne. Zagaye ɗaya ta hanyar faɗi 20+10+20+10=60 cm, ta hanyar tsawo 15+10+15+10=50 cm, saboda haka 60+50+25=135 cm daidai ne.
z-m-14-14.s.s2.prompt: Shagon ribbon yana da yanki guda na ƙarshe mai tsawon 120 cm. Yi girman akwati murabba'i mabambanta guda 3 da za a iya ɗaure su da wannan yanki ta wannan hanya (giciye, kullin 25 cm), kuma girman ciki aƙalla 1500 cm³. (faɗi a≥tsawo b≥tsayi h, dukkansu cikakkun lambobi aƙalla 5 ne, raka'a cm.)
z-m-14-14.s.s2.hint.0: Ta amfani da hanyar da ka gano a sama, zaɓi faɗi, tsawo, tsayin farko ka lissaabi tsawon ribbon da ake buƙata.
z-m-14-14.s.s2.hint.1: Canza faɗi, tsawo, tsayi ba tare da ribbon ya wuce 120 cm ba, ka kwatanta girman cikin.
z-m-14-14.s.s2.fail.c1: Dole faɗi ≥ tsawo ≥ tsayi, tsayin kuma aƙalla 5.
z-m-14-14.s.s2.ok.c3: Ana iya ɗaure da ribbon 120 cm.
z-m-14-14.s.s2.fail.c3: Ribbon (zagaye guda ta faɗi + zagaye guda ta tsawo + kulli 25 cm) ya wuce 120 cm.
z-m-14-14.s.s2.fail.c4: Girman cikin bai kai 1500 cm³ ba. Gwada ƙara girman akwatin ko canza siffarsa.
z-m-14-14.s.s2.explain: Tsawon ribbon shi ne (faɗi×2+tsayi×2)+(tsawo×2+tsayi×2)+25 = faɗi×2+tsawo×2+tsayi×4+25. Domin ya zama 120 cm ko ƙasa da haka, faɗi×2+tsawo×2+tsayi×4 dole ya zama 95 ko ƙasa da haka. Misali, 15×15×8 yana buƙatar ribbon 117 cm, girman cikin 1800 cm³. 20×12×6 yana buƙatar 113 cm amma girman cikinsa 1440 cm³ ne, bai dace ba.

z-m-14-07.topic: Rabo da ainihin adadi: lokacin da adadin tushe ya bambanta.
z-m-14-07.goal: Ka nuna da misalan da ka ƙirƙira cewa girman kaso da ainihin yawan mutane na iya kwatanta dabam idan adadin tushe (jimillar mutane) ya bambanta; nemo dalilin da ya sa bai kamata a ƙiyasta matsakaicin kaso na azuzuwan biyu ba yayin haɗawa.
z-m-14-07.material: A ƙungiyar karatun bayan makaranta, 40% na ɗaliban Aji na 3 da 25% na Aji na 5 sun shiga. Har yanzu ba ka san jimillar ɗalibai a azuzuwan biyu ba. Ajin yana da aƙalla ɗalibai 15, aƙalla kuma 50. Adadin ɗaliban da suka shiga cikakkiyar lamba ce (mutum ba ya rabuwa gida biyu).

z-m-14-07.s.s1.hint.1: Gwada zaɓar adadin ɗalibai dabam ga Aji na 3 da Aji na 5, ka duba ko ajin da ya fi yawan mambobi yana canzawa.

z-m-14-07.s.s1.r.a: Ka yanke hukuncin cewa kaso ɓangare ne na duka, saboda haka don kwatanta ɗaliban da suka shiga kana buƙatar jimillar ɗalibai.

z-m-14-07.s.s1.o.d: Aji na 3 yawanci zai fi yawa, amma ba tabbas ba. 40% ya fi girma sosai.

z-m-14-07.s.s1.o.e: Sun yi daidai. Domin a azuzuwan biyun wasu ɗalibai ne kawai suka shiga.
z-m-14-07.s.s1.r.e: Duba ko kasancewar 'wasu' dalili ne na adadin ɗaliban da suka shiga ya zama iri ɗaya.
z-m-14-07.s.s1.explain: Kaso ɓangare ne na duka, saboda haka don kwatanta adadin ɗaliban da suka shiga kana buƙatar sanin jimillar azuzuwan biyu. Misali, idan Aji na 3 yana da ɗalibai 20, masu shiga 8 ne; idan Aji na 5 yana da 40, masu shiga 10 ne, don haka Aji na 5 na iya fi yawa.

z-m-14-11.s.s2.o.c: Siffar da aka gani daga gaba alwatika ce.

z-m-14-11.s.s2.o.e: Siffar da aka gani daga gaba da’ira ce.
z-m-14-11.s.s2.r.e: Ka zaɓi ta bayan gano cewa siffa guda ɗaya ce kawai ke da gaban da’ira.
z-m-14-11.s.s2.explain: Idan gaban murabba’i mai tsawo ne, silinda ce; idan alwatika ne, mazuru ce; da’ira kuma ƙwallo ce. Ana iya sanya girma (diamita) ko tsawo iri ɗaya ga siffofin ukun, saboda haka ba za su tantance siffa ba.

z-m-14-01.title: Tafiya da gudun kilomita 60 a awa guda da dawowa da gudun kilomita 40 a awa guda: menene matsakaicin gudun tafiyar dawowa?
z-m-14-01.topic: Matsakaicin gudun tafiyar dawowa: lokacin da tazarar tafiyar biyu iri ɗaya ce da lokacin tafiyar biyu iri ɗaya ne
z-m-14-01.goal: Gwada da misalan lambobi tunanin ƙiyasta matsakaicin gudun tafiya da dawowa a matsayin ‘tsakiyar gudu biyu’, sannan ka bayyana yadda sakamako ke bambanta idan an riƙe tazara ɗaya da idan an riƙe lokaci ɗaya.
z-m-14-01.material: Iyalin Mina sun je gidan kaka da mota sun dawo ta hanya ɗaya. Zuwa sun yi gudun 60 km a awa (saurin tafiyar km 60 cikin awa ɗaya) daga farko zuwa ƙarshe; dawowa kuma 40 km a awa daga farko zuwa ƙarshe, babu hutawa. Tazarar zuwa da dawowa iri ɗaya ce. ‘Matsakaicin gudun tafiya-da-dawowa’ shi ne gudun awa ɗaya da za ka samu idan ka yi duk hanyar a gudu ɗaya. Ba ka san tazarar km ba tukuna.
z-m-14-01.thinking.0: Gwada ƙiyasin farko da lambobi na zahiri
z-m-14-01.thinking.1: Sake duba hukunci da ƙarfin gwiwa bayan ganin sabon bayani
z-m-14-01.thinking.2: Sauya tazara don ganin ko sakamako yana canzawa
z-m-14-01.thinking.3: Gano sharadin da sakamakon ya danganta da abin da aka riƙe iri ɗaya
z-m-14-01.prereq.0: Ma’anar gudu: tazarar da aka yi cikin awa ɗaya (gudu a awa)
z-m-14-01.prereq.1: Sauya ma’aunin lokaci (awa 1 da minti 30 = awa 1.5)
z-m-14-01.prereq.2: Lissafi da lambobi cikakku da ƙididdigar goma (aji na 5–6)
z-m-14-01.s.s1.prompt: Duk lokacin da aka ƙara bayani, zaɓi tunaninka game da matsakaicin gudun tafiya-da-dawowa. Ba dole ka sauya tunaninka na farko ba. Tantance da kanka ko shaidar ta isa.
z-m-14-01.s.s1.hint.0: A kowane mataki zaɓi tazara, fara gano awannin da tafiyar zuwa da dawowa suke ɗauka.
z-m-14-01.s.s1.hint.1: Karanta sabon bayani ka kwatanta ɗaya bayan ɗaya abin da ya yi da wanda ya bambanta da tunaninka na farko.
z-m-14-01.s.s1.st.0.info: Zuwa gudun 60 km a awa ne, dawowa 40 km a awa. Ba ka san tazarar hanya guda ko lokacin da aka ɗauka ba tukuna.
z-m-14-01.s.s1.st.0.ask: Idan aka kalli wannan bayanin kawai, me kake tunani game da matsakaicin gudun tafiya-da-dawowa?
z-m-14-01.s.s1.st.0.after: Ba a tabbatar da ɗaya daga cikin tunanin ba tukuna. Zaɓar tazara ka lissafa kai tsaye zai taimaka maka yanke hukunci.
z-m-14-01.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Daidai gudun 50 km a awa ne. Domin tsakiyar 60 da 40 ne.
z-m-14-01.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Wannan tunani ne da ke ɗaukar tsakiyar gudu biyu a matsayin matsakaici. Daga baya za ka iya gwada lokacin da yake aiki.
z-m-14-01.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Da alama zai yi ƙasa da 50 km a awa. Domin lokacin tuƙi a ƙaramin gudu ya fi tsawo.
z-m-14-01.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Ka yi tunani ba kan gudu kawai ba, har da tsawon lokacin da aka yi a kowane gudu.
z-m-14-01.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Da alama zai fi 50 km a awa. Domin sun yi sauri a hanyar zuwa.
z-m-14-01.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Ka kalli ɓangaren sauri kawai. Yana da kyau ka duba ko lokacin tafiyar tazara iri ɗaya ya yi daidai a yanayin biyun.
z-m-14-01.s.s1.st.0.o.d: Ba mu san tazara ta hanya guda ba, don haka ba za mu san matsakaicin gudun ba.
z-m-14-01.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Wannan tunani ne da ya dace a gwada kai tsaye ko da gaske ana buƙatar sanin tazara.
z-m-14-01.s.s1.st.1.info: A ce tazarar hanya guda 120 km ce. Zuwa yana ɗaukar awa 2, dawowa awa 3. Wato tafiyar 240 km gabaɗaya cikin awa 5.
z-m-14-01.s.s1.st.1.ask: Bayan ganin sakamakon lissafin, me kake tunani game da matsakaicin gudun tafiya-da-dawowa?
z-m-14-01.s.s1.st.1.after: Idan tazarar hanya guda 120 km ce, ba 50 km a awa ba ne. To me zai faru idan tazarar ta bambanta?
z-m-14-01.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Za mu iya ɗauka gudun 50 km a awa ne. Tsakiyar 60 da 40 ce, saboda haka ba ta canzawa.
z-m-14-01.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Ba ka kwatanta ko sakamakon lissafi ya saɓa wa ƙiyasin farko ba. Kwatanta da darajar tafiyar 240 km cikin awa 5.
z-m-14-01.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Gudun 48 km a awa ne. Sun yi 240 km cikin awa 5, kamar sun yi 48 km a kowace awa.
z-m-14-01.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Ka tabbatar da matsakaici ta amfani da jimillar tazara da jimillar lokaci.
z-m-14-01.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Idan tazarar hanya guda 120 km ce, gudun 48 km a awa ne. Har yanzu ba mu san ko darajar za ta canza idan tazara ta canza ba.
z-m-14-01.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Wannan hukunci ne na taka-tsantsan: ko da an samu sakamako ga yanayi guda, ana son duba dabam ko zai yi daidai ga sauran tazara.
z-m-14-01.s.s1.st.1.o.d: Gudun 52 km a awa ne. Sun yi sauri a hanyar zuwa, saboda haka ya fi 50.
z-m-14-01.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Idan ka duba lokutan da ka lissafa (awa 2 da awa 3), an yi dogon lokaci a ɓangaren mai jinkiri. Yi tunanin yadda wannan ke bayyana a matsakaici.
z-m-14-01.s.s1.st.2.info: Ka kuma lissafa tazara guda 60 km da 300 km. 60 km: awa 1 zuwa, awa 1 da minti 30 dawowa, jimillar 120 km cikin awa 2 da minti 30. 300 km: awa 5 zuwa, awa 7 da minti 30 dawowa, jimillar 600 km cikin awa 12 da minti 30.
z-m-14-01.s.s1.st.2.ask: Idan aka duba duk yanayin tazarar 60 km, 120 km, 300 km, wane hukunci za ka yanke?
z-m-14-01.s.s1.st.2.after: A duk tazara ukun da aka gwada gudun 48 km a awa ne. Amma hakan bai tabbatar da tazarorin da ba a gwada ba.
z-m-14-01.s.s1.st.2.o.a: A yanayi ukun, gudun 48 km a awa ne. A waɗannan tazara uku ya yi daidai ko da tazara ta canza.
z-m-14-01.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Ka taƙaita sakamakon tare da fayyace zangon da aka gwada.
z-m-14-01.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Mafi tsawon tazara, mafi girman matsakaicin gudun tafiya-da-dawowa.
z-m-14-01.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Jera matsakaitan gudun yanayi ukun kusa da juna ka kwatanta.
z-m-14-01.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Mun gwada sau uku, saboda haka an riga an tabbatar gudun 48 km a awa ne ga kowace tazara.
z-m-14-01.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Ka warware kowane yanayi da misalai kaɗan kawai. Daidaiton wasu misalai kaɗan ba hujja ba ne.
z-m-14-01.s.s1.st.2.o.d: Matsakaici ya bambanta ga kowace tazara, saboda haka ba za mu iya faɗin daraja guda ba.
z-m-14-01.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Da alama ka faɗi haka ba tare da kwatanta sakamakon yanayi ukun ba. Sake duba lambobin.
z-m-14-01.s.s1.st.3.info: A wannan karon mu riƙe lokaci ɗaya maimakon tazara. Zuwa sun yi awa 2 da gudun 60 km a awa, dawowa kuma awa 2 da 40 km a awa. Tazara ta ɓangarorin biyu na iya daina zama iri ɗaya.
z-m-14-01.s.s1.st.3.ask: Menene matsakaicin gudun tafiya-da-dawowa a wannan yanayi?
z-m-14-01.s.s1.st.3.after: Lokacin da aka riƙe tazara iri ɗaya gudun 48 km a awa ne, idan an riƙe lokaci iri ɗaya kuma 50 km a awa ne. Matsakaici ya danganta da abin da aka riƙe.
z-m-14-01.s.s1.st.3.o.a: Ya yi ƙasa da 50 km a awa. Da farko ya yi ƙasa da 50, saboda haka a wannan karon ma haka.
z-m-14-01.s.s1.st.3.r.a: Abin da aka riƙe da farko (tazara) da abin da aka riƙe yanzu (lokaci) sun bambanta, amma ka miƙa sakamakon kamar yadda yake.
z-m-14-01.s.s1.st.3.o.b: Ba za mu iya sani ba domin ba mu san tazara ba.
z-m-14-01.s.s1.st.3.r.b: A wannan karon lokaci ƙayyadadde ne, saboda haka za ka iya gano tazarar tafiyar kowanne ɓangare.
z-m-14-01.s.s1.st.3.o.c: Gudun 50 km a awa ne. Sun yi 120 km da 80 km, jimilla 200 km cikin awa 4.
z-m-14-01.s.s1.st.3.r.c: Ka sake lissafi bisa sabon sharadi (lokaci ɗaya) don tabbatarwa.
z-m-14-01.s.s1.st.3.o.d: Gudun 48 km a awa ne. Da farko 48 ne, don haka yanzu ma iri ɗaya ne.
z-m-14-01.s.s1.st.3.r.d: Ka yi amfani da tsohon sakamako yadda yake ga yanayi inda sharadi ya sauya. Sake lissafi ƙarƙashin sabon sharadi.
z-m-14-01.s.s1.reflect: Da farko gudun 50 km a awa ya fi yiwuwa, amma da aka riƙe tazara iri ɗaya gudun 48 ne. Gudun 50 ne kawai idan aka riƙe lokaci ɗaya. Tuna wane bayani ya sauya hukuncinka, ko bai buƙaci sauyawa ba.
z-m-14-01.s.s2.prompt: Hyewon ta ce, ‘Matsakaicin gudun tafiya-da-dawowa tsakiyar gudu biyun ne.’ Bayyana da lambobin da ka gani a sama yanayin da furucin yake daidai da wanda ba daidai ba.
z-m-14-01.s.s2.hint.0: Babu laifi ka fara rubuta ɗaya daga yanayin biyun kawai.
z-m-14-01.s.s2.hint.1: Ka fara jumlar da ‘Idan ... iri ɗaya ne.’
z-m-14-01.s.s2.placeholder: Misali, don tsakiyar gudu biyun ya yi daidai ...
z-m-14-01.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Za ka iya bi da lambobin da ka rubuta yadda matsakaicin gudun ya zama 48 ko 50 km a awa?
z-m-14-01.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Shin ka bambance ‘idan tazara iri ɗaya ce’ da ‘idan lokaci iri ɗaya ne’?
z-m-14-01.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Shin ka guji cewa tsakiyar gudu biyun koyaushe ce matsakaici?
z-m-14-01.s.s2.model.0: Don 50, tsakiyar gudu biyu, ya zama daidai, lokacin da aka yi tafiyar zuwa da dawowa dole ya yi daidai. Idan tazara iri ɗaya ce, dawowa na ɗaukar lokaci mai tsawo, saboda haka an fi yin tuƙi a ƙaramin gudun 40 kuma matsakaici 48 ne, ƙasa da 50.
z-m-14-01.s.s2.model.1: Idan tazarar hanya guda 120 km ce, zuwa yana ɗaukar awa 2, dawowa awa 3, saboda haka 240 km cikin awa 5, wato 48 km a awa. Amma idan an tuƙa awa 2 kowanne, an yi 120+80=200 km cikin awa 4, wato 50. Ya danganta ko tazara ko lokaci ne aka riƙe iri ɗaya.
z-m-14-01.s.s2.modelNote.1: An rubuta misalan lambobi ƙarƙashin sharudda biyu dabam.

z-m-14-02.title: Faɗaɗa hoto don ya dace da firam gaba ɗaya
z-m-14-02.topic: Tsawaitawa da rabo iri ɗaya da sharuddan zangon
z-m-14-02.goal: Idan aka faɗaɗa faɗi da tsawon hoto da rabo iri ɗaya, ƙirƙiri girma da dama da za su shiga cikin sharadin girman firam, sannan ka nemo mafi girman da zai shiga.
z-m-14-02.material: Doyun yana son buga hoto mai faɗin 12 cm da tsawon 9 cm ya saka a firam. Don kada hoton ya murɗe, dole a faɗaɗa faɗi da tsawo da rabo iri ɗaya. Cikin firam yana da faɗin 30 cm da tsawon 21 cm. Dole hoton gaba ɗaya ya shiga (faɗi bai wuce 30 cm ba, tsawo bai wuce 21 cm ba), hoton kuma ya fi yanzu girma. Rubuta tsawo a cm, ana iya amfani da gurbin goma ɗaya.
z-m-14-02.thinking.1: Ƙirƙiri mafita da ta cika sharudda da dama (rabo da zango) lokaci guda
z-m-14-02.thinking.2: Lura cewa cika gefe guda na iya sa ɗayan ya zube
z-m-14-02.s.s1.prompt: Doyun ya ce, ‘Mu faɗaɗa shi ta yadda faɗin zai zama 30 cm daidai, kamar faɗin cikin firam.’ Hoton zai shiga firam idan muka yi haka?
z-m-14-02.s.s1.hint.0: Da farko gano sau nawa 12 cm ya kamata ya ninka don zama 30 cm.
z-m-14-02.s.s1.hint.1: Idan tsawo ma ya canza sau ɗaya haka, gano tsawon cm ɗin sannan ka kwatanta da cikin firam na 21 cm.
z-m-14-02.s.s1.o.a: Zai shiga. Faɗin ya yi daidai da faɗin ciki 30 cm, saboda haka hoton duka ya shiga.
z-m-14-02.s.s1.r.a: Ka yi tunanin faɗi kawai ya isa ya shiga. Ba ka duba abin da zai faru da tsawon ba.
z-m-14-02.s.s1.o.b: Ba za mu iya sani ba. Ba za mu iya sanin tsawo ba sai an faɗaɗa an auna.
z-m-14-02.s.s1.r.b: Ka manta cewa za ka iya gano tsawon kafin faɗaɗawa ta amfani da rabo na farko.
z-m-14-02.s.s1.o.c: Zai shiga. Faɗaɗa faɗi zuwa 30 cm, sannan ka rage tsawo dabam zuwa 21 cm.
z-m-14-02.s.s1.r.c: Ka manta cewa idan aka daidaita faɗi da tsawo dabam-dabam, siffar hoton tana canzawa.
z-m-14-02.s.s1.o.d: Ba zai shiga ba. Idan an faɗaɗa da rabo ɗaya, tsawo zai wuce 21 cm na cikin firam.
z-m-14-02.s.s1.r.d: Ka yi amfani da rabo don duba yadda tsawo ke ƙaruwa tare da faɗi idan aka faɗaɗa faɗin zuwa 30 cm.
z-m-14-02.s.s1.explain: Idan faɗi ya tashi daga 12 cm zuwa 30 cm, ninkawa sau 2.5 ce. Tsawo ma ya zama sau 2.5, 9×2.5=22.5 cm, ya wuce tsawon ciki 21 cm, saboda haka bai shiga ba.
z-m-14-02.s.s2.prompt: Ƙirƙiri faɗaɗa uku daban-daban inda hoton bai murɗe ba kuma ya shiga firam. (faɗi w, tsawo h, naúrar cm)
z-m-14-02.s.s2.hint.0: Raba faɗin 12 cm da tsawon 9 cm zuwa murabba’ai masu gefen iri ɗaya, ka gano yawan murabba’ai a faɗi da tsawo.
z-m-14-02.s.s2.hint.1: Zaɓi faɗi, gano tsawon da ya dace da rabo, sannan ka duba sharuddan biyu (ba fiye da 30 ba, ba fiye da 21 ba).

z-m-14-02.s.s2.ok.c2: Rabon faɗi da tsawo iri ɗaya ne da na hoton asali (12:9).
z-m-14-02.s.s2.fail.c2: Rabon faɗi da tsawo ba 12:9 ba ne. Hoton ya murɗe.
z-m-14-02.s.s2.fail.c3: Dole faɗi bai wuce 30 cm ba kuma tsawo bai wuce 21 cm ba don shiga firam.
z-m-14-02.s.s2.explain: 12:9 daidai yake da 4:3. Idan faɗi murabba’ai 4 ne, tsawo ya zama 3, saboda haka (16 12),(20 15),(24 18),(28 21) masu yiwuwa ne. Mafi girman hoton da ya cika rabo iri ɗaya kuma ya shiga girman ciki faɗi 28 cm, tsawo 21 cm ne.
z-m-14-02.s.s2.because.prompt: Hoto mafi girma nawa cm ne a faɗi da zai shiga firam? Bayyana tare da dalilin da ya sa ba ka zaɓi faɗi 30 cm ba.

z-m-14-04.title: A wurin nishaɗi, hawa nawa ne zai sa tikitin wucewa ya yi amfani?

z-m-14-04.goal: Kwatanta hanyoyin biyan kuɗi biyu da ke canzawa bisa yawan hawa da tebur da furuci, gano cewa mafi arha da iyakar suna danganta da yawan hawa, sannan a taƙaita a matsayin shawara.
z-m-14-04.material: Iyalin Minseo sun zaɓi ɗaya daga hanyoyi biyu a wurin nishaɗi. Hanya A: sayen tikitin hawa marar iyaka da 20000원, ba a ƙara biyan komai ko da hawa nawa aka yi. z-m-14-05.title: Haɗa murabba'ai 10 da sandunan ashana.
z-m-14-05.topic: Nemo ƙa'ida ka rubuta a matsayin alamar lissafi (murabba'ai na ashana).
z-m-14-05.goal: Nemo ƙa'idar tsakanin adadin murabba'ai da sandunan ashana da ake buƙata, yanke ko alamomi mabambanta suna nuna ƙa'ida ɗaya, sannan ka gano ka gyara kuskuren ƙirga ƙa'idar.
z-m-14-05.material: Yi siffofi ta haɗa murabba'ai a jere da sandunan ashana. Ana buƙatar ashana 4 don murabba'i 1, 7 don haɗa murabba'ai 2, 10 don murabba'ai 3. Inda murabba'ai suka taɓa yayin haɗawa, ashana guda ɗaya suke rabawa. Kada a karya ashana ko a ɗora su juna.
z-m-14-05.thinking.0: Nemo ƙa'ida, ka faɗaɗa ta gaba ɗaya.
z-m-14-05.thinking.2: Bincika ko alamomi mabambanta suna nuna ƙa'ida ɗaya.
z-m-14-05.prereq.0: Nemo adadin siffa na gaba a tsarin da ke da ƙa'ida (aji na 5).
z-m-14-05.prereq.1: Amfani da □ don nuna dangantakar lambobi (aji na 5 zuwa 6).
z-m-14-05.s.s1.prompt: Seoyun ta nemo yawan sandunan ashana da ake buƙata don haɗa murabba'ai 10 kamar ƙasa. Zaɓi layi na farko da ba daidai ba.
z-m-14-05.s.s1.hint.0: Lissafta yanayin murabba'ai 2 da wannan alama, ka duba ko ya dace da ainihin 7.
z-m-14-05.s.s1.hint.1: Ƙirga sau nawa ka yi 'ƙara ɗaya' daga murabba'i 1 zuwa 10.
z-m-14-05.s.s1.line.0: Ana buƙatar ashana 4 ga murabba'i 1, 7 ga 2, 10 ga 3.
z-m-14-05.s.s1.line.1: Duk lokacin da adadin murabba'ai ya ƙaru da ɗaya, ashana suna ƙaruwa da 3.
z-m-14-05.s.s1.line.2: Saboda haka ga murabba'ai 10, yana ƙaruwa da 3 sau 10 daga farkon 4, 4+3×10=34.
z-m-14-05.s.s1.explain: Layi na 3 ba daidai ba ne. 4 na farko tuni ƙimar murabba'i 1 ce, saboda haka don kaiwa murabba'ai 10, yawan ƙarin 9 ne ba 10 ba. 4+3×9=31 daidai ne, 34 na layi na ƙarshe ma ba daidai ba ne sakamakon hakan.
z-m-14-05.s.s2.prompt: Zaɓi duk alamomin da ke nuna daidai yawan sandunan ashana idan murabba'ai □ ne. (Yadda ake karantawa: × ninka ne, − ragewa.)
z-m-14-05.s.s2.hint.0: Saka 1, 2, 3 a □ a kowace alama, ka duba ko sun yi daidai da ainihin lambobi 4,7,10. Ainihin adadin ashana: 4, 7, 10.
z-m-14-05.s.s2.hint.1: Ko alamomi suna kama dabam, duba ko wasu suna ba da lamba ɗaya ta saka lamba ɗaya a □ ka kwatanta.
z-m-14-05.s.s2.r.a: Wannan alama ce da ta ƙirga gefunan da suka taɓa sau ɗaya fiye. Idan □=2, tana ba da 8, wanda ya bambanta da ainihin 7.
z-m-14-05.s.s2.r.b: Wannan yana bayyana ƙa'idar ƙaruwa da 3 kowane lokaci, tare da na farko 1 dabam.
z-m-14-05.s.s2.r.c: Ka ɗauki adadin gefunan da suka ruɓanya a matsayin □. Ƙirga wuraren taɓawa idan an haɗa murabba'ai □.
z-m-14-05.s.s2.r.d: Ka ƙirga duk gefunan kowanne murabba'i, sannan ka cire adadin wuraren da suka taɓa.

z-m-14-05.s.s2.r.f: Ka bayyana ta fara ɗaukar murabba'i na farko 1, sannan ƙara 3 ga kowanne sauran.
z-m-14-05.s.s2.explain: Murabba'i 1 yana buƙatar ashana 4, duk lokacin da aka haɗa guda kuma yana ƙaruwa da 3. Saboda haka 4+3×(□−1), 4×□−(□−1), da 3×□+1 duk ƙa'ida ɗaya ce. Za ka iya tabbatar ta saka murabba'ai 1,2,3 ka ga ko 4,7,10 ne. Murabba'ai 1: 4; 2: 7; 3: 10.

z-m-14-05.s.s3.hint.1: Rubuta nawa adadin ke ƙaruwa kowane lokaci da aka ƙara guda, da yawan wuraren taɓawa.
z-m-14-05.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Hanyoyin biyun da gaske mabambanta ne?
z-m-14-05.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ka tabbatar alamar daidai ce da lambobi ƙanana (murabba'ai 2 da 3)?
z-m-14-05.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ka bambanta ko amsar 31 ƙima ce da ka ƙirga a zahiri ko ta fito daga alama?

z-m-14-05.s.s3.model.1: 31. 3×10+1=31. Ƙirga ta hanyar fara sanya gefe tsaye 1 sannan ƙara 3 ga kowanne murabba'i a siffar baka ma 31 ne. An kuma tabbatar ta cire gefuna masu ruɓani: 4×10−9=31.
z-m-14-05.s.s3.modelNote.1: An yi ƙirga ta hanyoyi mabambanta.

z-m-14-10.title: Idan aka manne kwalaye biyu wuri guda, me zai faru da fannin saman?
z-m-14-10.topic: Fannin saman da aka samu ta haɗa siffofi
z-m-14-10.goal: Nemo kuskuren da ke cikin hanyar warwarewa ta ‘tara fannin saman kowanne kawai’ yayin nemo fannin saman siffar da aka yi ta haɗa murabba'in tsawo biyu, sannan ka yanke shawarar sharaɗin da wurin haɗin yake shafar fannin saman.
z-m-14-10.material: Ka ɗora ƙaramin murabba'in tsawo B (faɗi 4 cm, tsawo 6 cm, tsayi 3 cm) a saman babban murabba'in tsawo A (faɗi 10 cm, tsawo 6 cm, tsayi 4 cm), ka manne su su zama siffa guda. Dukkan gindin B (faɗi 4 cm, tsawo 6 cm) yana taɓa saman A, kuma tsawon B na 6 cm daidai yake da tsawon A na 6 cm, saboda haka fuskokin gaba da baya sun yi layi ɗaya. Kana son fenti dukkan fuskokin siffar da ake iya gani daga waje (har da fuskar ƙasa). ‘Fannin saman’ shi ne jimillar fannin dukkan fuskokin da ake iya gani daga waje.
z-m-14-10.thinking.1: Yanke shawarar ko yadda (wurin da aka zaɓa) aka haɗa siffofin yana canza sakamakon
z-m-14-10.thinking.2: Bayyana yadda ƙarshe ke canzawa idan sharuɗɗan suka canza
z-m-14-10.prereq.0: Nemo fannin saman murabba'in tsawo (aji na 5)
z-m-14-10.s.s1.prompt: Seohyeon ta nemo fannin saman haka. Zaɓi layi ɗaya da ba daidai ba.
z-m-14-10.s.s1.hint.0: Nemo fuskokin da ba za a iya gani daga waje ba bayan an haɗa A da B.
z-m-14-10.s.s1.hint.1: Ka bincika ko an haɗa fannin fuskokin da ba a iya gani a kowanne daga cikin 248 da 108.
z-m-14-10.s.s1.line.2: Fannin saman siffar da aka haɗa shi ne jimillar fannin saman A da B: 248+108=356 cm².
z-m-14-10.s.s1.line.3: Saboda haka fannin da za a fenti shi ne 356 cm².
z-m-14-10.s.s1.explain: Layi na 3 ba daidai ba ne. Bangaren da saman A da gindin B suke taɓa juna (4×6=24 cm²) ba za a iya ganinsa daga waje bayan haɗawa ba. Amma an haɗa fuskar saman A mai fanni 24 cm² cikin 248, haka kuma an haɗa gindin B mai fanni 24 cm² cikin 108, don haka ba a cire waɗannan sassan da aka ɓoye ba. 356−24−24=308 cm² ne daidai, kuma saboda haka 356 cm² da ke layi na ƙarshe ba daidai ba ne.
z-m-14-10.s.s2.prompt: Ana iya manne B a ko'ina muddin duk gindin B yana taɓa cikin fuskar saman A. Mingi ta manne B a ƙarshen hagu na fuskar saman A, Hayun kuma ta manne shi a kusa da tsakiyar fuskar (a duka biyun, tsawon B daidai yake da tsawon A). Yaya fannin saman siffofin biyun ya kwatanta?
z-m-14-10.s.s2.hint.0: Nemo fannin wurin taɓawa a kowace daga cikin siffofin biyu.
z-m-14-10.s.s2.hint.1: Yi tunanin ko idan wurin taɓawa iri ɗaya ne, filin da ya ɓuya ma iri ɗaya ne.
z-m-14-10.s.s2.o.a: Na Mingi ƙarami ne. Domin a gefen hagu ɓangarorin sun yi layi, saboda haka sun fi rufe juna.
z-m-14-10.s.s2.r.a: Ka ɗauki gefunan da suka yi layi a fuska ɗaya daidai da fuskar da ta ɓuya. Ko sun yi layi, filin da aka nuna ba ya raguwa.
z-m-14-10.s.s2.o.b: Na Hayun ya fi girma. Domin idan aka haɗa shi tsakiyar, sababbin gefuna suna bayyana a ɓangarorin B biyu.
z-m-14-10.s.s2.r.b: Ka ɗauki ƙarin gefuna a matsayin ƙarin fili. Lissafa filayen fuskokin.
z-m-14-10.s.s2.o.c: Ba za ka iya kwatanta daskararrun biyu ba sai ka auna daidai matsayin haɗin.
z-m-14-10.s.s2.r.c: Gano ko abin da ake buƙata don tantance filin saman shi ne ainihin matsayin ko filin taɓawa.
z-m-14-10.s.s2.o.d: Filayen saman daskararrun biyu iri ɗaya ne. Domin filin taɓawa iri ɗaya ne ko da ina aka haɗa shi.
z-m-14-10.s.s2.r.d: Ka kwatanta ta gano ko filin fuskokin da suka ɓuya iri ɗaya ne duk da bambancin matsayi.
z-m-14-10.s.s2.explain: Matukar duk ƙasan B ya taɓa saman A, filin taɓawa 24 cm² ne duk inda aka haɗa. Saboda haka filin da ya ɓuya iri ɗaya ne, filin saman kuma iri ɗaya ne, 308 cm².
z-m-14-10.s.s3.prompt: Hayun ta zamar da B gefe ta manna shi, ta yadda 3 cm na faɗin B mai 4 cm ya wuce saman A, 1 cm kaɗai kuma yake kan saman A (zurfin B ɗaya yake da na A). Shin filin saman iri ɗaya ne da lokacin manna B cikin saman A? Gano darajar ka rubuta dalili.
z-m-14-10.s.s3.hint.0: Rubuta faɗi da tsawon ɓangaren fuskar ƙasan B da ya taɓa ainihin saman A.
z-m-14-10.s.s3.hint.1: Idan filin taɓawa 24 ne, kwatanta nawa aka cire daga 356.
z-m-14-10.s.s3.placeholder: Misali, ba iri ɗaya ba ne. Domin ...
z-m-14-10.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Shin ka bayyana cewa abin da ya bambanta da daskararre na farko shi ne ‘filin taɓawa’?
z-m-14-10.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Shin ka rubuta da lambobi cewa filin taɓawa ya canza daga 24 cm² zuwa 6 cm²?
z-m-14-10.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Shin ka fayyace abin da aka cire daga 356 da adadin?
z-m-14-10.s.s3.model.0: Ba iri ɗaya ba ne. Idan 3 cm ya fito waje, fuskar da ta taɓa A 1×6=6 cm² ce kawai; saboda haka ka cire 12, wato sau biyu na 6, daga jimillar filayen saman 356, ka samu 344 cm².
z-m-14-10.s.s3.model.1: Yana canzawa. Filin taɓawa ya ragu daga 24 zuwa 6, don haka filin da ya ɓuya ya ragu daga 48 zuwa 12, filin saman kuma ya ƙaru: 356−12=344.
z-m-14-10.s.s3.modelNote.1: Ka bayyana ta amfani da canjin filin da ya ɓuya.

z-m-14-06.title: Idan mutane sun ninka sau biyu, aikin zai ƙare cikin rabin lokaci?
z-m-14-06.topic: Yawan mutanen da ke aiki tare da lokacin da ake buƙata (binciken sharudda).
z-m-14-06.goal: Nemo sharuddan da ake buƙata domin hukuncin 'idan yawan mutane ya ninka, lokaci ya rabi' ya yi aiki, sake duba hukuncinka idan sabon bayani ya karya sharadi.

z-m-14-06.thinking.0: Nemo sharuddan da dole su tabbata domin ƙarshe ya biyo baya.
z-m-14-06.thinking.1: Yanke hukunci ko sabon bayani yana canza sharuddan.
z-m-14-06.prereq.0: Ra'ayin cewa adadin aiki yana ƙaruwa idan yawan ma'aikata da kwanakin aiki suka ƙaru (aji na 5).
z-m-14-06.prereq.1: Matsalolin kalmomi masu haɗa ninkawa da rabo (aji na 5).
z-m-14-06.s.s1.prompt: Me dole ne ya zama gaskiya don maganar Jihun 'za a gama cikin kwanaki 4' ta zama daidai? Zaɓi duk abin da ake buƙata.
z-m-14-06.s.s1.hint.0: Baya ga 'yawan mutane ya ninka', rubuta ɗaya bayan ɗaya abin da dole iri ɗaya ya kasance a yanayin biyun.
z-m-14-06.s.s1.hint.1: Ka yi tunanin yanayin da aikin ba ya raguwa ko lokacin ya canza ko da yawan mutane ya ƙaru.
z-m-14-06.s.s1.o.a: Sabbin mutane 3 ɗin suna aji ɗaya.
z-m-14-06.s.s1.r.a: Wannan bayani ba shi da alaƙa kai tsaye da yawan aiki ko gudu. Nemo ko yana canza lokacin da ake buƙata.
z-m-14-06.s.s1.o.b: Idan mutane da yawa suka yi aiki, aikin yana ƙare da wuri.
z-m-14-06.s.s1.r.b: Hanyar tunani daidai ce, amma ba sharadin 'rabin daidai' ba. Bincika ko adadin saurin ƙarewa yana kayyade.
z-m-14-06.s.s1.o.c: Kowa yana aiki da gudu kusan iri ɗaya.
z-m-14-06.s.s1.r.c: Ka yi tunanin cewa idan gudun mutum ya bambanta sakamakon zai iya canzawa.
z-m-14-06.s.s1.o.d: Ciyawar da mutane 6 suka cire ta ninka ta mutane 3.
z-m-14-06.s.s1.r.d: Idan yawan aikin ya canza, lokacin na iya zama iri ɗaya ko da mutane sun ƙara. Duba ko ya dace da sharadi na farko.
z-m-14-06.s.s1.o.e: Ko da mutane 6 ne, za su iya raba aikin su yi aiki lokaci ɗaya ba tare da hana juna ba.
z-m-14-06.s.s1.r.e: Ka yi tunanin cewa ko da mutane sun ƙaru, dole su iya raba aikin su yi lokaci ɗaya.
z-m-14-06.s.s1.o.f: Lokacin aiki a kowace rana iri ɗaya ne, awa ɗaya ga mutane 3 da 6.
z-m-14-06.s.s1.r.f: Ka yi tunanin cewa dole ne lokacin aiki ya yi daidai domin kwatanta yawan mutane kawai.
z-m-14-06.s.s1.explain: Dole ne kowa ya yi aiki da gudu kusan iri ɗaya, kada su hana juna, su raba aikin su yi lokaci guda, kuma su yi awa ɗaya iri ɗaya kowace rana domin lokacin ya rabi idan yawan mutane ya ninka. Matsalar tuni ta ce ciyawar da za a cire iri ɗaya ce.
z-m-14-06.s.s2.prompt: Ka gano lambun yana da fartuunai 3 kawai, ciyawar kuma sai an yi amfani da fartuunai za a iya cirewa. Idan mutane 6 suka raba fartuunai 3, suka yi aiki awa 1 kowace rana, kusan kwanaki nawa zai ɗauka?
z-m-14-06.s.s2.hint.0: Da farko rubuta adadin mutanen da za su iya aiki lokaci ɗaya da fartuunai 3.
z-m-14-06.s.s2.hint.1: Idan wasu mutane suna hutawa yayin da mutane 6 ke musayar aiki, kwatanta yadda adadin da ake cirewa kowace rana ya bambanta da lokacin mutane 3.
z-m-14-06.s.s2.o.a: Kwanaki 4 ne. Yawan mutane ya ninka zuwa 6, saboda haka lokaci ya rabi ko da fartuunai nawa ne.
z-m-14-06.s.s2.r.a: Ba ka gwada ƙa'idar 'idan mutane sun ƙaru lokaci ya ragu' da sabon bayani kamar adadin fartuunai ba.
z-m-14-06.s.s2.o.b: Ya fi kwanaki 4. Mutane 3 ne kawai ke aiki lokaci guda, saboda haka kusan kwanaki 8 zai ɗauka.
z-m-14-06.s.s2.r.b: Ka sake duba hukuncinka bisa sabon bayanin da ya canza 'adadin hannayen da ke aiki lokaci guda'.
z-m-14-06.s.s2.o.c: Kwanaki 6 ne. Ko da fartuunai suna nan, kusan tsakiyar 4 da 8 zai ɗauka.
z-m-14-06.s.s2.r.c: Ka zaɓi matsakaicin ƙimar sabon bayani ba tare da dalili ba.
z-m-14-06.s.s2.o.d: Ba za mu san ainihin adadin kwanaki ba. Muna buƙatar ƙarin bayani, kamar ko za a iya cirewa da hannu.
z-m-14-06.s.s2.r.d: Ka nuna sharadin da ba a faɗa a matsalar ba zai iya canza sakamakon. Ka fahimci bayanai sun rasa, hukunci ne mai taka-tsantsan.
z-m-14-06.s.s2.explain: Idan fartuunai 3 ne kawai, mutane 3 ne kawai za su yi lokaci guda, saboda haka ko da mutane 6 ne aikin yana ci gaba ne kamar mutane 3. Zai ɗauki fiye da kwanaki 4, kuma tunda wasu suna hutawa kusan kwanaki 8 ne. Hukuncin 'muna buƙatar ƙarin bayani kamar hanyar cirewa da hannu' ma yana da tushe.
z-m-14-06.s.s2.acc.0: Hukuncin cewa ana buƙatar wasu sharudda, kamar ko akwai masu cirewa da hannu, ma yana da kyau. Zai fi kyau a tabbatar cewa da fartuunai kawai kusan kwanaki 8 ne.
z-m-14-06.s.s3.prompt: Rubuta abin da za ka faɗa wa Jihun. Ba da sharadi guda da mutane 6 za su gama cikin kwanaki 4, da yanayi guda da ba za su gama cikin kwanaki 4 ba.
z-m-14-06.s.s3.hint.1: Yi tunanin yanayin da samun mutane 6 ya zama mara amfani, ka rubuta shi a jimla.
z-m-14-06.s.s3.placeholder: Misali: Idan kowa yana aiki da gudu iri ɗaya, ...
z-m-14-06.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ka rubuta dabam sharadin gama cikin kwanaki 4 da yanayin da ba kwanaki 4 ba?
z-m-14-06.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ka bayyana cewa yanayin da ka rubuta da gaske yana ƙara lokaci?
z-m-14-06.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ka guji cewa ba tare da sharadi ba 'idan mutane sun ninka, lokaci koyaushe rabin ne'?
z-m-14-06.s.s3.model.0: Idan kowa yana aiki da gudu iri ɗaya, za su iya raba aikin su yi lokaci ɗaya, mutane 6 za su gama cikin kwanaki 4. Amma idan fartuunai 3 kawai ne, mutane 3 ne kawai ke aiki lokaci guda, saboda haka fiye da kwanaki 4 zai ɗauka.
z-m-14-06.s.s3.model.1: Domin mutane 6 su gama cikin kwanaki 4, gudun kowane mutum dole ya yi daidai kuma kada su hana juna. Idan sabon mutum yana tafiyar hawainiya ko suka cunkushe a wuri ƙunci suna hana juna, zai iya ɗaukar fiye da kwanaki 4.
z-m-14-06.s.s3.modelNote.1: Ka ba da wani yanayi dabam a matsayin misali.

z-m-14-08.title: Idan muka fenti babban kube sannan muka rarraba shi zuwa ƙananan tubalan guda-guda fa?
z-m-14-08.topic: Kube da aka gina da ƙananan tubalan da adadin fuskokin da aka fenti
z-m-14-08.goal: Yayin da yawan tubalan da ke kan gefen kube da aka gina da ƙananan tubalan yake canzawa, ka duba lokuta da dama don gyara hasashenka game da yadda yawan tubalan masu fuskokin fenti iri-iri yake canzawa, sannan ka bayyana ta amfani da tsarin siffar (fuskoki, gefuna, kusurwoyi).
z-m-14-08.material: Ka jera ƙananan tubalan (ƙananan kube masu gefen 1 cm) don gina babban kube mai tubalan □ a kowane gefe. Ka fenti dukkan fuskoki shida na wajen babban kuben ja (ka ɗauka cewa an fenti fuskar da ta taɓa ƙasa ma), sannan ka cire tubalan ɗaya bayan ɗaya. Daga nan ka ware su zuwa masu fuskokin fenti 0, 1, 2, ko 3. Ka yi la'akari da lokutan da akwai tubalan 3 ko fiye a kowane gefe kawai.
z-m-14-08.thinking.0: Hasashen ƙa'ida daga wasu lokuta da gwada ta da sabon hali
z-m-14-08.thinking.1: Kwatanta hasashen cewa adadin yana ƙaruwa daidai a kowane mataki da hasashen da ya dogara da tsarin siffar
z-m-14-08.thinking.2: Bambance lokutan da adadin ba ya canzawa da waɗanda yake canzawa
z-m-14-08.prereq.0: Fuskoki, gefuna da kusurwoyin murabba'in tsawo da kube (aji na 4–5)
z-m-14-08.prereq.1: Ƙidaya yawan tubalan da ke cikin siffar da aka gina da ƙananan tubalan (aji na 5–6)
z-m-14-08.s.s1.prompt: Yayin da kake ganin bayanai ɗaya bayan ɗaya, ka yi hasashen yawan tubalan masu fuska 1 da aka fenti (kuma a ƙarshe, yawan masu fuskoki 3 da aka fenti). Ba dole ba ne ka canza hasashenka na farko. Ka yanke shawara da kanka ko sabon bayani ya canza ra'ayinka ko kuwa zai iya kasancewa yadda yake.
z-m-14-08.s.s1.hint.0: A kowane mataki, ka rubuta sabbin lambobin da aka bayar a tebur tare da yawan tubalan da ke kan gefe.
z-m-14-08.s.s1.hint.1: Ka yi tunanin fuska ɗaya ta babban kube, cire jeri ɗaya a gefenta, sannan ka ƙidaya adadin da suka rage a ciki.
z-m-14-08.s.s1.st.0.info: Ka gina shi da tubalan 3 a kowane gefe (3×3×3, jimilla 27), ka fentin shi, sannan ka warware shi. Akwai tubalan 6 kacal masu fuska 1 da aka fenti. Wannan shi ne guda ɗaya a tsakiyar kowace fuska daga cikin fuskoki shida na babban kube.
z-m-14-08.s.s1.st.0.ask: Idan ka gina shi da tubalan 6 a kowane gefe (6×6×6, jimilla 216), kusan tubalan nawa ne za su sami fuska 1 kacal da aka fenti?
z-m-14-08.s.s1.st.0.after: Yana da wuya a dogara da ƙa'ida daga girma ɗaya kawai. Mu kuma ƙidaya lokutan da ake da tubalan 4 da 5 a gefe.
z-m-14-08.s.s1.st.0.o.a: 6. Saboda babban kuben yana da fuskoki 6 kawai.
z-m-14-08.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Ka kalli yawan fuskoki kawai, ba ka yi la'akari da canjin yawan tubalan da ke kan fuska ɗaya ba.
z-m-14-08.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Kusan 12. Gefen ya ninka tsawo sau 2, saboda haka yawan ma zai ninka kusan sau 2.
z-m-14-08.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Wannan hasashe ne na daidaito, cewa idan tsawon ya ninka sau biyu, adadin ma zai ninka. Za ka iya gwada shi da sabon hali.
z-m-14-08.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Kusan 24. Fannin fuska ɗaya zai ninka sau 4, saboda haka adadin ma zai ninka kusan sau 4.
z-m-14-08.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Ka ɗauki yawan tubalan da ke kan fuska ɗaya a matsayin fanni.
z-m-14-08.s.s1.st.0.o.d: Yana da wuya a yi hasashe daga girma ɗaya kawai. Muna buƙatar ƙidaya wasu girman ma.
z-m-14-08.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Kana ganin hujjojin ba su isa ba tukuna, saboda haka kana son duba ƙarin lokuta.
z-m-14-08.s.s1.st.1.info: Ka gina shi da tubalan 4 a kowane gefe (4×4×4, jimilla 64), kuma akwai tubalan 24 masu fuska 1 kacal da aka fenti. A kowace fuska akwai na tsakiya 2×2=4, a fuskoki shida. Da tubalan 3 a gefe adadin ya zama 6, da tubalan 4 kuma ya zama 24.
z-m-14-08.s.s1.st.1.ask: Bayan ganin waɗannan sakamako biyu, kusan tubalan nawa ne za su sami fuska 1 kacal da aka fenti idan akwai tubalan 6 a kowane gefe?
z-m-14-08.s.s1.st.1.after: Akwai hanyoyi biyu na hasashen ƙa'idar. Ɗaya shi ne ɗaukar ƙarin adadin a matsayin tsayayye, ɗayan kuma shi ne duba siffar fuska ɗaya kai tsaye. Mu gwada da hali na uku.
z-m-14-08.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Kusan 60. Ya ƙaru da 18 daga 3 zuwa 4, saboda haka zai ƙaru da 18 a kowane lokaci.
z-m-14-08.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Wannan hasashe ne da ke ɗaukar ƙarin adadin a lokutan biyu a matsayin iri ɗaya. Za ka iya gwada shi da hali na gaba.
z-m-14-08.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Kusan 96. Cire layukan gefen fuska, ƙidaya murabba'in ciki, sannan ka ƙidaya fuskoki shida.
z-m-14-08.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Ka yi hasashe ta hanyar ƙidaya kai tsaye bisa tsarin kube (murabba'in cikin fuska ɗaya).
z-m-14-08.s.s1.st.1.o.c: 12. Ya ninka daga 3 zuwa 6, saboda haka ya zama sau biyu na 6.
z-m-14-08.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Ka sake faɗin hasashenka na farko kamar yadda yake, ba tare da yin la'akari da sakamakon biyu da ka gani yanzu ba (6 → 24).
z-m-14-08.s.s1.st.1.o.d: Ban sani ba tukuna. Ya kamata in ƙidaya halin tubalan 5 a gefe ma, in duba ko ƙa'idar daidai ce.
z-m-14-08.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Wannan hukunci ne mai lura, ba a kammala ƙa'ida daga lokuta biyu ba, ana son gwada wani guda kuma.
z-m-14-08.s.s1.st.2.info: Ka gina shi da tubalan 5 a kowane gefe (5×5×5, jimilla 125), kuma akwai tubalan 54 masu fuska 1 kacal da aka fenti. Ya zuwa yanzu, adadin shi ne 6 (ga tubalan 3), 24 (ga tubalan 4), da 54 (ga tubalan 5).
z-m-14-08.s.s1.st.2.ask: Yanzu, kusan tubalan nawa ne za su sami fuska 1 kacal da aka fenti idan akwai tubalan 6 a kowane gefe?
z-m-14-08.s.s1.st.2.after: Ko ka duba ƙarin adadin (18, 30, 42) ko murabba'in cikin fuska ɗaya, amsar 96 ce. Idan hanyoyi biyu sun ba da ƙima iri ɗaya, hasashen ya fi zama abin dogaro.
z-m-14-08.s.s1.st.2.o.a: 60. Ina tsammanin zai ƙaru da 18 a kowane lokaci kamar da.
z-m-14-08.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Ƙarin adadin, 18 da 30, bai kasance tsayayye ba. Ka duba ko ƙa'idar da ta gabata ma ta dace da sabon sakamakon.
z-m-14-08.s.s1.st.2.o.b: 96. Ƙarin adadin 18 da 30 ya ƙaru da 12, saboda haka sai ka ƙara 42 a gaba.
z-m-14-08.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Ka gano ƙa'idar ta hanyar duba yadda ƙarin adadin yake canzawa ma.
z-m-14-08.s.s1.st.2.o.c: 78. Ka ƙara 24, matsakaicin ƙarin adadin 18 da 30, ga 54.
z-m-14-08.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Ƙarin adadin ba tsayayye ba ne, amma ka ɗauke shi a matsayin matsakaici. Ka duba yadda ƙarin adadin yake canzawa.
z-m-14-08.s.s1.st.2.o.d: 96. A kowace fuska, cire gefen, ƙidaya 4×4=16 na ciki, sannan ka ninka da fuskoki shida.
z-m-14-08.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Ka ƙidaya kai tsaye bisa tsarin kube, kuma ka samu ƙima iri ɗaya.
z-m-14-08.s.s1.st.2.o.e: Ba za ka iya tabbatarwa ba sai ka gina 6×6×6 da gaske, sannan ka ƙidaya.
z-m-14-08.s.s1.st.2.r.e: Wannan hali ne na taka-tsantsan da ke bambanta hasashe da bincike kai tsaye. Yana sa ka yi tunanin yadda za ka tabbatar ƙa'idar ta dace sosai.
z-m-14-08.s.s1.st.3.info: Yawan tubalan masu fuskoki 3 da aka fenti ya kasance 8 lokacin da ake da tubalan 3, 4, da 5 a kowane gefe.
z-m-14-08.s.s1.st.3.ask: Tubalan nawa ne za su sami fuskoki 3 da aka fenti idan akwai tubalan 6 a kowane gefe?
z-m-14-08.s.s1.st.3.after: Tubalan masu fuskoki 3 da aka fenti suna kan kusurwoyi 8 na babban kube kawai. Ko da tsawon gefe ya canza, yawan kusurwoyi zai kasance iri ɗaya, wato 8.
z-m-14-08.s.s1.st.3.o.a: 16. Ya ninka daga 3 zuwa 6, saboda haka adadin ma zai ninka.
z-m-14-08.s.s1.st.3.r.a: Ka ɗauki kwarewar canjin adadin tubalan masu fuska 1 da aka fenti yayin da tsawon gefe yake canzawa, ka yi amfani da ita yadda take ga tubalan masu fuskoki 3 da aka fenti.
z-m-14-08.s.s1.st.3.o.b: 8. Domin akwai guda ɗaya a kowace kusurwa daga cikin kusurwoyi 8 na babban kube.
z-m-14-08.s.s1.st.3.r.b: Ka bayyana dalilin da ya sa adadin bai canza ba ta amfani da tsarin kube (yawan kusurwoyi).
z-m-14-08.s.s1.st.3.o.c: 24. Ya ninka sau 4 kamar tubalan masu fuska 1 da aka fenti.
z-m-14-08.s.s1.st.3.r.c: Ka yi amfani da canjin da ya faru ga wani nau'in tubali kamar yadda yake.
z-m-14-08.s.s1.st.3.o.d: Sau uku adadin ya kasance 8, saboda haka da alama zai zama 8, amma ya kamata mu ƙidaya halin tubalan 6 ma.
z-m-14-08.s.s1.st.3.r.d: Ka duba sakamakon dukkan lokuta ukun, kana son tabbatarwa a hankali.
z-m-14-08.s.s1.reflect: Tubalan masu fuska guda ɗaya kacal da aka fenti sun kasance 6, 24, 54, 96 ga tubalan 3, 4, 5, 6 a gefe, suna ƙaruwa da sauri sosai, ba daidai da tsawon gefe ba. Tubalan masu fuskoki uku da aka fenti sun tsaya a 8. Ka sake duba wane bayani ne ya canza hasashenka (ko dalilin da ya sa bai buƙaci canzawa ba), da kuma lokacin da hanyar hasashen bisa ƙarin adadi da hanyar hasashen bisa tsarin siffar suka ba da ƙima iri ɗaya.
z-m-14-08.s.s2.prompt: A cikin babban kube mai tubalan 6 a kowane gefe, tubalan nawa ne suke da fuskoki 2 da aka fenti? Ka bayyana yadda ka sani.
z-m-14-08.s.s2.hint.0: Ka rubuta yawan gefunan babban kube da yawan tubalan da ke kan gefe ɗaya.
z-m-14-08.s.s2.hint.1: Ka ƙidaya nawa daga cikin tubalan da ke kan gefe ɗaya suke a kusurwoyi, da nawa ne sauran.
z-m-14-08.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Hanyar da na rubuta tana bayyana ba kawai yadda ake lissafawa ba, har da inda waɗannan tubalan suke a cikin babban kube kuwa?
z-m-14-08.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ka bincika ko hanyata daidai ce ga sauran girma (tubalan 3 da 4) kuwa?
z-m-14-08.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ka duba ko jimillar tubalan masu fuskokin fenti 0, 1, 2, da 3 ta zama 216 kuwa?
z-m-14-08.s.s2.model.0: Akwai 48. Kube yana da gefuna 12, kuma daga tubalan 6 da ke kan gefe, idan aka cire 2 da ke ƙarshen (kusurwoyi), sai 4 a kowane gefe, don haka 12×4=48.
z-m-14-08.s.s2.model.1: Da tubalan 3 a gefe adadin ya zama 12, da tubalan 4 ya zama 24, da 5 kuma 36. Saboda haka duk lokacin da aka ƙara tubali ɗaya a tsawon gefen, adadin yana ƙaruwa da 12. Da tubalan 6 zai zama 48. Haka kuma jimillar ta yi daidai: 8+48+96+64=216.
z-m-14-08.s.s2.modelNote.1: Ka bincika ƙa'idar da jimillar adadin.

z-m-14-09.title: Kimanta fannin da'ira ta amfani da grid
z-m-14-09.topic: Kimanta fannin da'ira (ƙidaya murabba'ai a grid)
z-m-14-09.goal: Ta amfani da murabba'ai da grid ɗin ya ƙunsa gaba ɗaya da kuma waɗanda da'irar ta rufe wani ɓangare, ka bayyana iyakar fannin da'irar, sannan ka bincika hasashenka ta lura da yadda iyakar take canzawa idan aka rage girman murabba'ai.
z-m-14-09.material: An zana da'ira mai radius 5 cm a kan takardar grid mai murabba'ai masu faɗi 1 cm da tsawo 1 cm (fanni 1 cm²). Cibiyar da'irar tana a kusurwa ɗaya ta grid. Akwai murabba'ai 60 gaba ɗaya a cikin da'irar, kuma idan aka haɗa murabba'ai da layin da'irar ya ratsa, jimillar murabba'ai aƙalla sun ɗan shiga cikin da'irar ita ce 88. Ka ɗauka ba a koya maka yadda ake nemo fannin da'ira ba tukuna.
z-m-14-09.thinking.0: Bayyana ta amfani da iyaka maimakon ƙima daidai
z-m-14-09.thinking.1: Samar da hasashe da dama da suka cika sharuɗɗan
z-m-14-09.thinking.2: Bincika da gyara hasashe bisa sabon bayani
z-m-14-09.prereq.0: Ma'anar fanni da ƙidaya murabba'ai masu fanni 1 cm² (aji na 3–4)
z-m-14-09.prereq.1: Sassan da'ira (radius, diamita) da ma'anar pi (aji na 6, zangon farko)
z-m-14-09.s.s1.prompt: Me za ka iya cewa game da fannin da'irar bisa sakamakon wannan ƙidaya ta grid?
z-m-14-09.s.s1.hint.0: Ka zana murabba'ai ɗaya bayan ɗaya, sannan ka yi tunanin alaƙar murabba'ai da suke cikin da'irar gaba ɗaya da waɗanda aka rufe wani ɓangarensu da fannin da'irar.
z-m-14-09.s.s1.hint.1: Ka bincika ko fannin da'irar zai iya zama ƙasa da 60, da kuma ko zai iya wuce 88.
z-m-14-09.s.s1.o.a: Fannin da'irar shi ne 60 cm². Murabba'ai da suke cikinta gaba ɗaya ne kawai ake ɗauka a matsayin ɓangaren da'irar.
z-m-14-09.s.s1.r.a: Ba ka lura cewa murabba'ai da layin da'irar ya ratsa suna da wani ɓangare a cikin da'irar ma ba.
z-m-14-09.s.s1.o.b: Fannin da'irar shi ne 88 cm². Dukkan murabba'ai da layin ya ratsa ɓangare ne na da'irar.
z-m-14-09.s.s1.r.b: Ba ka yi la'akari da cewa murabba'ai da layin ya ratsa suna cikin da'irar ne a wani ɓangare kawai ba.
z-m-14-09.s.s1.o.c: Fannin da'irar ya fi 60 cm² kuma ya gaza 88 cm².
z-m-14-09.s.s1.r.c: Ka yi amfani da fannin murabba'ai da ke cikin da'irar gaba ɗaya da na murabba'ai da suka ɗan shiga ciki aƙalla, don bayyana iyaka.
z-m-14-09.s.s1.o.d: Fannin da'irar daidai yake da 74 cm². Saboda shi ne tsakiyar 60 da 88.
z-m-14-09.s.s1.r.d: Ka tabbatar da cewa tsakiyar iyaka ita ce ainihin ƙima. Babu yadda za a san ko rabin murabba'ai da aka rufe wani ɓangare suke cikin da'irar.
z-m-14-09.s.s1.explain: Da'irar ta fi murabba'ai 60 da ke cikinta gaba ɗaya girma, kuma ta gaza murabba'ai 88 da suka ɗan shiga ciki aƙalla. Saboda haka za mu iya cewa ta fi 60 cm² kuma ta gaza 88 cm².
z-m-14-09.s.s2.prompt: Ka rubuta ƙimomi uku daban-daban (a cm²) da kake ganin hasashe ne mai ma'ana ga fannin wannan da'ira. (Ka rubuta su a matsayin lambobi cikakku.)
z-m-14-09.s.s2.hint.0: Ka yi tunanin wasu lambobi da suka fi 60 kuma suka gaza 88.
z-m-14-09.s.s2.hint.1: Ka yi tunanin matsakaicin ɓangaren murabba'ai 28 da aka rufe kaɗan (88−60) da zai iya kasancewa cikin da'irar, sannan ka yanke shawarar hasashe.
z-m-14-09.s.s2.fail.c1: Dole ne fannin da'irar ya fi 60 cm² kuma ya gaza 88 cm².
z-m-14-09.s.s2.explain: Duk lamba cikakkiya da ta fi 60 cm² kuma ta gaza 88 cm² hasashe ne a cikin iyakar. Misali, 70, 74, 78, da 80 duk sun dace. Wace ƙima ce ta fi zama abin dogaro ya danganta da yawan murabba'ai da aka rufe kaɗan da ke cikin da'irar.
z-m-14-09.s.s2.because.prompt: Daga cikin hasashe ukun da ka rubuta yanzu, zaɓi wanda kake ganin ya fi zama abin dogaro, sannan ka rubuta dalilin da ya sa kake tunanin haka.
z-m-14-09.s.s2.because.hint.0: Da farko ka rubuta ƙimar idan duk murabba'ai 28 da aka rufe kaɗan suna cikin da'irar, da kuma idan babu ko ɗaya daga cikinsu da yake ciki.
z-m-14-09.s.s2.because.hint.1: Ka rubuta a jimla ɗaya inda ƙimar da ka zaɓa take tsakanin waɗannan biyu.
z-m-14-09.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Ƙimar da na zaɓa tana tsakanin 60 da 88 kuwa?
z-m-14-09.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Na bayyana a matsayin dalili tunanina game da yawan murabba'ai 28 da aka rufe kaɗan da ke cikin da'irar kuwa?
z-m-14-09.s.s2.because.selfAssess.2: Da alama ka rubuta ne da sanin cewa ba za a iya sanin ainihin ƙimar ba kuwa?
z-m-14-09.s.s2.because.model.0: 74 cm² ƙima ce mai dogaro. Idan na ƙara murabba'ai 14, wato rabin murabba'ai 28 da aka rufe kaɗan, ga murabba'ai 60 da ke cikin da'irar gaba ɗaya, zai zama 60 + 14 = 74. Wannan ba ainihin ƙima ba ce, kuma ina ganin za ta ƙara zama daidai idan aka raba murabba'ai zuwa ƙanana.
z-m-14-09.s.s2.because.model.1: Na yanke shawarar 78 cm². Cikin iyakar da ta fi 60 kuma ta gaza 88, ina ganin fiye da rabin murabba'ai da aka rufe kaɗan suna cikin da'irar, saboda haka ainihin ƙimar za ta ɗan fi tsakiyar iyakar, 74.
z-m-14-09.s.s2.because.modelNote.1: Ka zaɓi ƙima da ta ɗan fi tsakiyar iyakar.
z-m-14-09.s.s3.prompt: Ka sake ƙidaya da'ira ɗaya a kan takardar grid mai murabba'ai 0.5 cm × 0.5 cm kowanne (fanni 0.25 cm²). Akwai murabba'ai 276 gaba ɗaya a ciki da murabba'ai 344 da suka ɗan shiga cikinta aƙalla. Idan aka mayar da wannan zuwa fanni, ya zama 69 cm² da 86 cm². Idan aka duba wannan sabon sakamako tare da na farko da hasashen da na rubuta, wane hukunci ne ya fi dacewa?
z-m-14-09.s.s3.hint.0: Ka nuna iyakar farko da sabuwar iyaka a kan layin lamba, sannan ka bincika ko suna da ɓangaren da suka haɗu.
z-m-14-09.s.s3.hint.1: Ka duba ɗaya bayan ɗaya ko hasashen da na rubuta yana cikin sabuwar iyakar.
z-m-14-09.s.s3.o.a: Fannin da'irar ya fi 69 cm² kuma ya gaza 86 cm². Iyakarta ta ƙara matsewa.
z-m-14-09.s.s3.r.a: Ka kwatanta sabon sakamako da na farko don ganin ko sun saɓa, sannan ka lura cewa iyakar ta ƙara matsewa.
z-m-14-09.s.s3.o.b: Iyakar ta bambanta da sakamakon farko, saboda haka an yi kuskure a ƙidayar farko.
z-m-14-09.s.s3.r.b: Ka ɗauki canjin iyakar a matsayin kuskure. Da farko ka bincika ko iyakokin biyun suna da ɓangaren da suka haɗu.
z-m-14-09.s.s3.o.c: An rage girman murabba'ai zuwa rabi, saboda haka yanzu za mu iya sanin ainihin fannin da'irar.
z-m-14-09.s.s3.r.c: Iyakar ta matse ne kawai, ba ta zama ƙima daidai ba. Har yanzu akwai murabba'ai da aka rufe wani ɓangarensu.
z-m-14-09.s.s3.o.d: 77.5 cm², tsakiyar sabuwar iyaka ta 69 zuwa 86, ita ce ainihin fannin da'irar.
z-m-14-09.s.s3.r.d: Ka tabbatar da cewa tsakiyar iyakar ita ce ainihin ƙima.
z-m-14-09.s.s3.explain: Sabon sakamakon, 69 zuwa 86, yana cikin sakamakon farko, 60 zuwa 88, kuma iyakar ta fi matsewa. Yayin da ake rage girman murabba'ai, iyakar tana ƙara matsewa. Idan hasashen da na rubuta yana wajen 69 zuwa 86 (misali, 65), sabon sakamakon ya kawar da shi, don haka abin da ya rage shi ne in gyara shi.

z-m-14-12.title: Tsawon igiyar da ke ɗaure gwangwani uku
z-m-14-12.topic: Kewaya da aka lissafa ta da’ira (ɗaure gwangwani)
z-m-14-12.goal: Ƙiyasta tsawon igiyar da ke zagaye gwangwani tana taɓa su ta raba zuwa ɓangaren madaidaiciya da zagaye, sannan ka kwatanta yadda tsawon ke canzawa bisa tsarin da aka jera.
z-m-14-12.material: Tsaya gwangwani silinda 3 masu diamita 6 cm, ka ɗaure su da igiya guda da aka ja sosai sau ɗaya a tsakiyar tsawonsu. Igiyar tana taɓa gefunan gwangwani babu gibi, kada ka ƙirga igiyar kulli. Yi amfani da π=3.14. Tsare-tsare biyu ne. (가) Sanya gwangwani ukun jere gefe da gefe suna taɓa juna. (나) Sanya ukun cikin siffar alwatika suna taɓa juna duka.
z-m-14-12.thinking.0: Tunanin kewaya ta raba siffa gida-gida
z-m-14-12.thinking.1: Gano da gyara kuskure a mafita
z-m-14-12.thinking.2: Kwatanta tsare-tsare biyu ka yanke hukunci da shaida
z-m-14-12.prereq.0: Pi da gano kewaya da’ira (aji na 6)
z-m-14-12.prereq.1: Alaƙar diamita da radius na da’ira
z-m-14-12.s.s1.prompt: Kafin lissafa tsawon igiyar da ake buƙata a tsare-tsare (가) da (나), fara ƙiyasta. Wanne kake ganin ya fi tsawo?
z-m-14-12.s.s1.hint.0: Zana da’irori ukun idan an kalle su daga sama, sannan ka zana hanyar da igiyar ke bi.
z-m-14-12.s.s1.hint.1: Yi alama ga wuraren da igiya ke canzawa daga zagaye zuwa madaidaiciya, ka ƙirga ɓangarorin madaidaiciya.
z-m-14-12.s.s1.o.a: (나) ya fi tsawo. Yana lanƙwasa zuwa alkibla uku, don haka igiyar ta bi ƙarin ɓangaren zagaye.
z-m-14-12.s.s1.r.a: Ka yi tunanin ƙarin lanƙwasa na sa tsawo ya ƙaru. Lissafa tsawon ɓangarorin da igiyar ke bi a kan zagayen.
z-m-14-12.s.s1.o.b: Tsare-tsaren biyu iri ɗaya ne. Kowanne yana zagaya gwangwani ukun gaba ɗaya. 3
z-m-14-12.s.s1.r.b: Ka manta cewa igiyar ba ta zagaya gwangwani duka ba; tsakanin gwangwani masu taɓa juna tana tafiya madaidaiciya ba tare da bin gefen ba.
z-m-14-12.s.s1.o.c: (가) ya fi tsawo. ɓangaren madaidaiciya tsakanin gwangwani ya fi tsawo a (가).
z-m-14-12.s.s1.r.c: Ka raba igiyar zuwa ɓangaren zagaye da madaidaiciya, ka kwatanta madaidaiciyar tsare-tsaren biyu.
z-m-14-12.s.s1.o.d: Ba za mu iya kwatantawa ba sai mun san tsawon gwangwani.
z-m-14-12.s.s1.r.d: Tsawon zagayen igiya yana ƙayyadewa ne da tsarin da aka gani daga sama. Ka yi tunanin ko tsawo yana sauya tsawon igiya.
z-m-14-12.s.s1.explain: Ana iya raba igiyar zuwa zagayen gwangwani da madaidaiciyar ɓangaren tsakanin su. A tsare-tsaren biyu, ɓangarorin zagaye idan an haɗa su suna yin kewayar gwangwani guda, madaidaiciyar ɓangaren kuma ta fi tsawo a (가). Saboda haka (가) da alama ya fi tsawo. Za a iya gwada ƙiyasin da lissafi.
z-m-14-12.s.s2.prompt: Hansol ya gano tsawon igiyar ɗaurewar (가) kamar haka. Zaɓi layi ɗaya da ba daidai ba.
z-m-14-12.s.s2.hint.0: Yi tunanin layin da ya haɗa cibiyoyin gwangwanin ƙarshen biyu, ka ƙirga yawan diamita da tsawonsa.
z-m-14-12.s.s2.hint.1: Duba ko gwangwani na tsakiya yana sauya tsawon ɓangarorin madaidaiciya.
z-m-14-12.s.s2.line.0: Wuraren da igiya ta taɓa za a raba zuwa ɓangarorin zagaye a ƙarshen gwangwanin da madaidaiciya a sama da ƙasa.
z-m-14-12.s.s2.line.1: Haɗa ɓangarorin zagaye na gwangwani biyu na ƙarshen ya ba da kewayar gwangwani guda, 6×3.14=18.84 cm.
z-m-14-12.s.s2.line.2: Madaidaicin ɓangaren sama yana da gwangwani 3 jere, don haka tsawonsa 6 cm ne. Na ƙasa ma 6 cm ne.
z-m-14-12.s.s2.explain: Layi na 3 ba daidai ba ne. Madaidaicin sama yana da tsawon tazara tsakanin cibiyoyin gwangwani ƙarshen, saboda haka gwangwani 3 jere suna da diamita 2, wato 12 cm. Na ƙasa ma 12 cm ne, don haka 18.84+12+12=42.84 cm daidai ne; 30.84 cm na layi na 4 sakamako ne na kuskuren.
